Scope: all requested windows returned completely (exit 0): current guidance 0–3 and all three rubrics; 4 complete EN/RU kanji lessons; 7 complete EN/RU context pairs; EN-only 公演 comparison; 9 KANJIDIC2 records, radical and header; 56 JMdict entries; 4 KanjiPedia texts; all 338 typed pool rows; all proposals, adjudications, clarifications, limits, and 5 exact nav diffs. No unread/failed windows.
C1 CLEAN: No confirmed Japanese-fact defect in the four lessons. Readings, counts (6/6/7/13), 囗 classical key 31, examples and cited senses agree with the frozen source and supplied KANJIDIC2/JMdict/KanjiPedia evidence; mnemonics are explicitly not etymologies. JLPT N3 is expressly called a community list, not an official claim.
C2 UNVERIFIED: All 5 edits are precisely navigation-only and link to existing kanji cards; new lesson links resolve within the reviewed scope. Each provisional distractor is a defensible introductory/source-core contrast, but ordinary active-negative safety is not established for any of the 12; retained metadata is not approval. No other confirmed correctable defect.
C3 CLEAN: The four lessons are understandable Russian and wrappers preserve readability. No confirmed comprehension defect; see optional terminology note. This is not a native-speaker or learning-outcome certification.
N001回→因 S-intro; 回 turn/count vs 因 cause/factor (JMdict 1199330/1604300 vs 1168640); ordinary negative U.
N002回→困 S-intro; turning/counting vs troubled/inconvenienced (1604300/1199330 vs 1289590); 回復 contexts show association, not equivalence; ordinary negative U.
N003回→国 S-intro; turn/count vs country/region/home (1199330/1604300 vs 1592250); touring regions does not make the senses interchangeable; ordinary negative U.
N004因→回 S-intro; cause/factor vs turn/count (1168640 vs 1199330/1604300); ordinary negative U.
N005因→困 S-intro; cause/factor vs trouble (1168640 vs 1289590); 因果’s adversity/ill-fated sense is an association, not the same gloss; ordinary negative U.
N006因→国 S-intro; cause/factor vs country/state/region (1168640 vs 1592250); ordinary negative U.
N007困→因 S-intro; troubled/inconvenienced vs cause/factor (1289590 vs 1168640); causal relationship is not synonymy; ordinary negative U.
N008困→回 S-intro; troubled vs turn/count (1289590 vs 1604300/1199330); ordinary negative U.
N009困→国 S-intro; trouble/poverty vs country/national government (1289590/1490830 vs 1592250); contexts can relate but senses differ; ordinary negative U.
N010園→国 S-intro; park/garden vs country/region/home (1176240/2854424 vs 1592250); spatial-domain affinity is a limit, not equivalence; ordinary negative U.
N011園→困 S-intro; park/garden vs troubled (1176240/2854424 vs 1289590); ordinary negative U.
N012園→回 S-intro; garden/park vs turn/count (1176240/2854424 vs 1604300/1199330); going around a park does not equate the meanings; ordinary negative U.
L001回 SUPPORTED-within-source: Counts, readings and rotation examples agree; mnemonic explicitly modern-shape only.
L002因 SUPPORTED-within-source: Cause/factor, compound examples and contrast with 理由 are bounded; no etymology asserted.
L003困 SUPPORTED-within-source: Intransitive/causative distinction and disclosed secondary 困る senses agree with evidence.
L004園 SUPPORTED-within-source: Park/garden readings and compounds agree; 公演 remains intentionally unwrapped as optional EN-only comparison.
A001 SUPPORTED-bounded: 回る/回す, direction, counter and listed alternate/rare senses accurately bounded.
A002 SUPPORTED-bounded: 因 senses and rare alternate spellings are distinguished; no frequency/etymology claim.
A003 SUPPORTED-bounded: 困る senses, 困らせる causative, and context-limited 難しい contrast are accurate.
A004 SUPPORTED-bounded: 園 senses and suffix usage, compounds and homophone 公演 are accurately distinguished.

NAV03 words/原因.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps standalone 因 with correct target; no other change.
NAV04 words/回る.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps standalone 回 with correct target; no other change.
NAV05 words/困る.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps standalone 困 with correct target; no other change.
Outside LIMIT dispositions:
O001: LIMIT, not a new guard; inherited 度/回 overlap on «раз/times», acknowledged in source.
O002: LIMIT, not a new guard; Russian «причина» overlap between 由 and 因 is introduced by RU titles; neither is a distractor here.
O003: LIMIT, not a new guard; trouble/adversity/poverty adjacency does not establish a new negative pair.
O004: LIMIT, not a new guard; garden/place/facility adjacency does not establish a new negative pair.
Findings: none confirmed. The unresolved quiz-safety status is stated under C2 and N001–N012, not treated as an approved guard.
Optional: For absolute beginners, briefly gloss «онное/кунное чтение» at first use; this is pedagogical polish, not a confirmed defect.
Limits: No active quiz/UI execution or independent guard-approval evidence was supplied or run (and was prohibited); ordinary negative safety remains UNVERIFIED. JLPT labels are transparently community classifications; the supplied evidence does not independently audit that community list. Review is bounded to the requested windows; no tests/builds/validators were run.
